test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/520ef6f0f676606fc0f9974dc344bc24e975082861dbd751dd1ea400c1cdcbcd.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +3, +2.

1. EHJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f45f48e3c33ccba38644e3cdbdb4993e43af442fd203b91f091aebc91516b1bc.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +3, +2.

2. DHI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dbe25589689d482385ffdc39d1cbab726e7ddf44d7d26a0e085659b05c0a831.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +3, +2.
3. KNP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca8f3237345233502075849e4ddc292f22eef32208a51c6aaa0c2b25c4a34d8.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +3, +2.
4. UXZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10c11e978d3cb9ab06a8425df6e96c4b83fdbe6db833da061f5c7d9e12f6029e.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +3, +2.

Thus, DHI is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**"
